doc:
`Polynomial R` is the type of univariate polynomials over `R`,
denoted as `R[X]` within the `Polynomial` namespace.

Polynomials should be seen as (semi-)rings with the additional constructor `X`.
The embedding from `R` is called `C`.

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → ∀ {i j : ℕ}, (Polynomial.monomial i) a = (Polynomial.monomial j) a ↔ i = j

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {k l m n : ℕ} {u v : R},
  u ≠ 0 →
    v ≠ 0 →
      (Polynomial.C u * Polynomial.X ^ k + Polynomial.C v * Polynomial.X ^ l =
          Polynomial.C u * Polynomial.X ^ m + Polynomial.C v * Polynomial.X ^ n ↔
        k = m ∧ l = n ∨ u = v ∧ k = n ∧ l = m ∨ u + v = 0 ∧ k = l ∧ m = n)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial R), ↑n * p = n • p

doc: Summing the values of a function applied to the coefficients of a polynomial
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → {S : Type u_1} → [AddCommMonoid S] → Polynomial R → (ℕ → R → S) → S

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ p.support, f n (p.coeff n)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] {p : Polynomial R} (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → ∀ {s : Finset ℕ}, p.support ⊆ s → p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ s, f n (p.coeff n)

doc: Expressing the product of two polynomials as a double sum.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p * q = ∑ i ∈ p.support, q.sum fun j a => (Polynomial.monomial (i + j)) (p.coeff i * a)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (f : ℕ → R → S), Polynomial.sum 0 f = 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] {n : ℕ} (a : R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  f n 0 = 0 → ((Polynomial.monomial n) a).sum f = f n a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {a : R} {β : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] {f : ℕ → R → β},
  f 0 0 = 0 → (Polynomial.C a).sum f = f 0 a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] {f : ℕ → R → S},
  f 1 0 = 0 → Polynomial.X.sum f = f 1 1

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p q : Polynomial R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → (∀ (a : ℕ) (b₁ b₂ : R), f a (b₁ + b₂) = f a b₁ + f a b₂) → (p + q).sum f = p.sum f + q.sum f

doc: See also `Polynomial.sum_add`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (f g : ℕ → R → S),
  p.sum (f + g) = p.sum f + p.sum g

doc: See also `Polynomial.sum_add'`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (f g : ℕ → R → S),
  (p.sum fun n x => f n x + g n x) = p.sum f + p.sum g

doc: See also `Polynomial.sum_smul_index'` for a version using `smul` on the RHS.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (b : R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → (b • p).sum f = p.sum fun n a => f n (b * a)

doc: See also `Polynomial.sum_smul_index` for a version using multiplication on the RHS.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst_1 : DistribSMul T R] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid S]
  (p : Polynomial R) (b : T) (f : ℕ → R → S), (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → (b • p).sum f = p.sum fun n a => f n (b • a)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] [inst_2 : DistribSMul T S]
  (p : Polynomial R) (b : T) (f : ℕ → R → S), b • p.sum f = p.sum fun n a => b • f n a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (p.sum fun n a => (Polynomial.monomial n) a) = p
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (p.sum fun n a => Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n) = p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {motive : Polynomial R → Prop} (p : Polynomial R),
  (∀ (a : R), motive (Polynomial.C a)) →
    (∀ (p q : Polynomial R), motive p → motive q → motive (p + q)) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : R),
          motive (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n) → motive (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ (n + 1))) →
        motive p

doc:
To prove something about polynomials,
it suffices to show the condition is closed under taking sums,
and it holds for monomials.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {motive : Polynomial R → Prop} (p : Polynomial R),
  (∀ (p q : Polynomial R), motive p → motive q → motive (p + q)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : R), motive ((Polynomial.monomial n) a)) → motive p

doc: `erase p n` is the polynomial `p` in which the `X^n` term has been erased.
statement: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R → Polynomial R

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (x : Polynomial R),
  Polynomial.erase n x =
    match x with
    | { toFinsupp := p } => { toFinsupp := AddMonoidAlgebra.erase n p }

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.erase n p).toFinsupp = AddMonoidAlgebra.erase n p.toFinsupp

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : AddMonoidAlgebra R ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  { toFinsupp := AddMonoidAlgebra.erase n p } = Polynomial.erase n { toFinsupp := p }
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.erase n p).support = p.support.erase n

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.monomial n) (p.coeff n) + Polynomial.erase n p = p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n i : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.erase n p).coeff i = if i = n then 0 else p.coeff i
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), Polynomial.erase n 0 = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {n : ℕ} {a : R}, Polynomial.erase n ((Polynomial.monomial n) a) = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.erase n p).coeff n = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) {n i : ℕ}, i ≠ n → (Polynomial.erase n p).coeff i = p.coeff i

doc:
Replace the coefficient of a `p : R[X]` at a given degree `n : ℕ`
by a given value `a : R`. If `a = 0`, this is equal to `p.erase n`
If `p.natDegree < n` and `a ≠ 0`, this increases the degree to `n`.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → R → Polynomial R

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (a : R),
  ⇑(p.update n a).coeff = Function.update (⇑p.coeff) n a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (a : R) (i : ℕ),
  (p.update n a).coeff i = if i = n then a else p.coeff i
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (a : R), (p.update n a).coeff n = a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) {n i : ℕ} (a : R), i ≠ n → (p.update n a).coeff i = p.coeff i
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), p.update n 0 = Polynomial.erase n p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (a : R) [inst_1 : Decidable (a = 0)],
  (p.update n a).support = if a = 0 then p.support.erase n else insert n p.support
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (p.update n 0).support = p.support.erase n

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → (p.update n a).support = insert n p.support

doc: The finset of nonzero coefficients of a polynomial.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R → Finset R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.coeffs 0 = ∅
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {c : R}, c ∈ p.coeffs ↔ ∃ n ∈ p.support, c = p.coeff n

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {s : Set R},
  ↑p.coeffs ⊆ s ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ), p.coeff n ≠ 0 → p.coeff n ∈ s

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {s : Finset R},
  p.coeffs ⊆ s ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ), p.coeff n ≠ 0 → p.coeff n ∈ s
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.coeffs 1 ⊆ {1}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ}, p.coeff n ≠ 0 → p.coeff n ∈ p.coeffs
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.coeffs = ∅ ↔ p = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.coeffs.Nonempty ↔ p ≠ 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) {c : R}, c ≠ 0 → ((Polynomial.monomial n) c).coeffs = {c}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (a : ℤ) (b : AddMonoidAlgebra R ℕ), { toFinsupp := a • b } = a • { toFinsupp := b }
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (a : ℤ) (b : Polynomial R), (a • b).toFinsupp = a • b.toFinsupp
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (z : ℤ), { toFinsupp := ↑z } = ↑z
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (z : ℤ), (↑z).toFinsupp = ↑z
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (-p).coeff n = -p.coeff n
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p q : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (p - q).coeff n = p.coeff n - q.coeff n
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (n : ℕ) (a : R), (Polynomial.monomial n) (-a) = -(Polynomial.monomial n) a

∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} [inst : Ring R] (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.monomial n) (a - b) = (Polynomial.monomial n) a - (Polynomial.monomial n) b
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p : Polynomial R}, (-p).support = p.support
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.C ↑n = ↑n
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Ring R], Polynomial.C (-a) = -Polynomial.C a
∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} [inst : Ring R], Polynomial.C (a - b) = Polynomial.C a - Polynomial.C b
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [Nontrivial R], Polynomial.X ≠ 0

doc:
See also `Polynomial.isCancelMulZero_iff`: in order for `R[X]` to have cancellative
multiplication (stronger than `NoZeroDivisors` in general, but equivalent if `R` is a ring),
`R` must have both cancellative multiplication and cancellative addition.
statement: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], NoZeroDivisors (Polynomial R) ↔ NoZeroDivisors R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : DivisionSemiring R] (q : ℚ≥0) (f : Polynomial R), q • f = Polynomial.C ↑q * f
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : DivisionRing R] (a : ℚ) (f : Polynomial R), a • f = Polynomial.C ↑a * f
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Nontrivial (Polynomial R) ↔ Nontrivial R

doc: The map sending a collection of roots into a polynomial, as a morphism.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → AddChar (Multiset R) (Polynomial R)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (s : Multiset R),
  Polynomial.ofMultiset s = (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) s).prod
